# AEM Code Analyser 1.0.6

<p class="muted">Released 2026-11-16 · <a href="../">All release notes</a> · <a href="https://github.com/RohithV16/aem-code-analyser/releases/tag/v1.0.6" rel="noopener">GitHub release</a></p>

> **Upgrading?** A rule added in a release can fail a gate that passed on the previous
> version. Run this version once on a branch (`aem-analyser . --no-html`) before bumping CI,
> and accept existing findings with `--update-baseline` when the change is deliberate.

## Fixed
{: #fixed}

- The release workflow's documented-version sync anchored on the development POM version instead of
  the newest tag, so it changed nothing (superseded in 1.0.8 by removing the rewrite entirely).
